correctness.rationale: For cubic G with a perfect matching, the complement is spanning disjoint cycles, which can be oriented to attain every triangle and external-link lower bound simultaneously. Local Ising inequalities at h=0,K,K+2J, together with affine interpolation, classify open regimes and equality cases. The plateau magnetization n is one-third of 3n spins. For G=K4, an independent 4096-spin enumeration verifies the critical counts 114 and 163 and their connected one-flip graphs of 216 and 444 edges. Only the general analytic proof covers arbitrary finite G; negative h follows by spin reversal.
